summary: Built the real React app shell (dark-theme design tokens, 64px icon nav rail, lightweight internal router across Dashboard/Services/Settings/device-detail/device-settings) matching the Pi Control design reference. Set up Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (radix base) per this work unit's declared component-system preference, replaced shadcn's default palette with tokens matching the design mockup, removed the create-tauri-app demo content, and added an ESLint flat config since none existed. Verified with npm run build, npm run lint, cargo build, and a live smoke test that screenshotted the running app and clicked through all three nav destinations.
completed: Installed and configured Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite) and shadcn/ui (radix base, Nova preset), adding the @/* path alias in vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json.

Replaced shadcn's default light/grayscale CSS variables in src/globals.css with a dark-only palette matching the Pi Control design reference (background/card/popover/border/muted/primary colors, a sidebar token group for the nav rail) plus custom --status-healthy/--status-warning/--status-offline/--status-neutral tokens for later use.
Set the font stack to 'Segoe UI Variable' matching the design, and removed the unused @fontsource-variable/geist dependency shadcn's init pulled in.
src/app/router.tsx: context-based router covering dashboard, device, deviceSettings, services, globalSettings screens.

src/components/layout/NavRail.tsx: Dashboard/Services/Settings icon buttons with active-state highlighting; intentionally dropped the design mockup's in-app tray flyout button since a real native system tray already exists (WU002).
src/components/layout/EmptyState.tsx + one placeholder screen per route under src/features/{dashboard,services,settings,devices}/.
Rewrote src/App.tsx to mount RouterProvider + AppShell; removed the create-tauri-app demo (greet UI, App.css, react.svg) and the now-unused greet Tauri command from lib.rs.
Added eslint.config.js (flat config: typescript-eslint + react-hooks + react-refresh) and an npm run lint script, since neither existed yet but this work unit's validation commands require it.
Verified npm run build and npm run lint pass, and cargo build still succeeds.

Live smoke test via npm run tauri dev: screenshotted the running app on Dashboard (matches the design's dark theme, nav rail, and empty-state styling), then simulated clicks on the Services and Settings nav icons and re-screenshotted, confirming both screens render and the active-nav highlight moves correctly.

validationCommands.summary: 0 errors, 2 warnings (react-refresh HMR-granularity notices on router.tsx and the shadcn-generated button.tsx, not correctness issues).
Backend still compiles cleanly after removing the unused greet command.

validationCommands.command: npm run tauri dev (live smoke test)
validationCommands.summary: Screenshotted the running app on Dashboard, then Services and Settings after simulated nav clicks; visuals match the design reference and navigation/active-state highlighting work.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Nav rail navigates between Dashboard, Services, and Settings placeholders
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Live screenshots before/after simulated clicks on each of the three nav icons show the correct screen and active highlight for each.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Visual style (colors, spacing, typography) matches the Pi Control Claude Design reference
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Screenshots show the dark background/card colors, nav rail styling, and blue accent matching docs/design/Pi Control.dc.html; tokens were transcribed directly from that file's inline styles.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No arbitrary command execution is exposed to the frontend from this shell
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: This work unit added no new Tauri commands or invoke() calls; the shell is presentation-only, and the demo greet command was removed rather than left in place.

notes: Risk score: 15/100 (low). Rationale: purely frontend/presentational change with no new backend commands, no persistence changes, no SSH surface; the riskiest part (getting Tailwind v4 + shadcn's CSS-variable theming wired correctly) was directly verified with live screenshots rather than relying on the build passing alone.

This project declares a shadcn/ui component-system preference per the AIQT work-unit packet's Component System Guidance; that wasn't part of the original architecture notes I captured (which only mentioned 'optional Radix UI primitives'), so I've now effectively locked in shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4 as the actual frontend component system going forward -- later UI work units (M4) should keep using shadcn primitives/wrappers rather than hand-rolled ones.

The design mockup's per-container 'Update' action and its in-app tray flyout were both deliberately excluded, per this work unit's stated out-of-scope and because a real system tray already exists, respectively.
